name: postmark-pp-mcp
description: One account token for every Postmark server, and a local archive that outlasts Postmark's 45-day retention.

postmark_account_token.title: POSTMARK_ACCOUNT_TOKEN
postmark_account_token.description: Optional. Account API token. Required for servers, domains, senders, template push, and data removals; also lets --server <name> look up server tokens.

postmark_server_token.title: POSTMARK_SERVER_TOKEN
postmark_server_token.description: Optional. Server API token for one Postmark server. Set this OR POSTMARK_ACCOUNT_TOKEN with --server <name>.
